# Rebuild brief: Marlowe Club: opiniões

You are rebuilding every page of the **Marlowe Club: opiniões** template, a reviews site (angle: support-focus). Keep the section order, the content and every rule below. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Portuguese); write code and comments in English.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section below with the listed fields as props.

## Site context

- Site: Marlowe Club: opiniões (https://marlowe-opinioes.example), brand or publisher: Marlowe Club
- Market: Brazil (`br`), language `pt`, text direction `ltr`, currency BRL
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports betting yes, online casino yes
- Market note: Regulated under Lei 14.790/2023. Licensed operators use .bet.br domains. Advance bonuses are prohibited; PIX is the default payment rail; credit cards are not accepted.
- Pages (7):
  - `index.html` — Marlowe Club é confiável? Opiniões de jogadores e atendimento
  - `reviews.html` — Todas as opiniões sobre o Marlowe Club
  - `reviews-2.html` — Todas as opiniões sobre o Marlowe Club · página 2
  - `support-reviews.html` — Atendimento do Marlowe Club: opiniões sobre chat e e-mail
  - `support-reviews-2.html` — Atendimento do Marlowe Club: opiniões sobre chat e e-mail · página 2
  - `write-a-review.html` — Escrever uma opinião sobre o Marlowe Club
  - `how-we-moderate.html` — Como moderamos as opiniões sobre o Marlowe Club

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): Cormorant Garamond, Montserrat.

Use these CSS custom properties (they are the whole palette, type scale and radius set):

```css
:root {
  --c-bg: #0F0D0B;
  --c-surface: #18150F;
  --c-surface-2: #221D16;
  --c-text: #F3ECDF;
  --c-muted: #B3A68F;
  --c-border: #3A3226;
  --c-accent: #D4AF6A;
  --c-on-accent: #1A140A;
  --c-accent-2: #8C6B3F;
  --c-success: #1F9D55;
  --c-warning: #D98B00;
  --c-danger: #D93636;
  --c-hero-text: #F3ECDF;
  --c-hero-muted: #C4B79F;
  --c-hero-accent: #D4AF6A;
  --c-hero-on-accent: #1A140A;
  --hero-bg: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 0%,rgba(212,175,106,.18),transparent 70%),#0F0D0B;
  --f-display: "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-body: "Montserrat",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "Montserrat",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --fw-heading: 600;
  --fw-body: 400;
  --fw-strong: 500;
  --tt-heading: none;
  --ls-heading: 0.005em;
  --lh-body: 1.65;
  --lh-heading: 1.15;
  --r-sm: 0px;
  --r: 2px;
  --r-lg: 4px;
  --r-btn: 0px;
  --bw: 1px;
  --density: 1.15;
  --fs-0: 12px;
  --fs-1: 16px;
  --fs-2: 28.43px;
  --fs-3: clamp(25.77px,20.57px + 1.444vw,37.9px);
  --fs-4: clamp(34.35px,27.42px + 1.924vw,50.52px);
  --fs-5: clamp(45.79px,36.56px + 2.565vw,67.34px);
  --fs-6: clamp(61.04px,48.73px + 3.42vw,89.76px);
  --sp-1: 4.6px;
  --sp-2: 9.2px;
  --sp-3: 13.8px;
  --sp-4: 18.4px;
  --sp-5: 27.6px;
  --sp-6: 36.8px;
  --sp-7: 55.2px;
  --sp-8: 73.6px;
  --sp-9: 110.4px;
  --card-bg: #18150F;
  --card-border: #3A3226;
  --card-shadow: none;
  --surface-style: outlined;
}
```

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Affiliate disclosure: Fixed wording per locale; cannot be removed on review sites.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Rating summary: No typed-in scores: everything comes from brands/reviews/<brand>.json.
- Rating summary: No AggregateRating structured data.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Review list: Newest first, every published review; never sorted or filtered by rating by default.
- Review list: The CTA sits between reviews, never inside a review card.
- Topic scores: Computed from the review feed; topics without reviews are hidden.
- Editor box: Person comes from the site config "editor" {name, role, bio}; renders nothing (and warns) without it.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Review form: No incentives for reviews. Asks only for a display name; never email, phone or account numbers.
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Marlowe Club é confiável? Opiniões de jogadores e atendimento
- Meta description: O que jogadores dizem do Marlowe Club no Brasil: atendimento no chat, saques PIX, verificação e app. Publicamos opiniões boas e ruins. 18+.
- The only H1: Opiniões de jogadores sobre o Marlowe Club
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `how-we-moderate.html`, `reviews.html`, `support-reviews.html`, `write-a-review.html`, `index.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `line`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `centered`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `note`: "Autorizado SPA/MF"
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
3. **Rating summary** — block `sx/rating-summary`, variant `band`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Hero for review sites: average score, review count, 5-to-1 distribution, one topic score and the CTA. Every number is computed from the review feed.
   - `title`: "Opiniões de jogadores sobre o Marlowe Club"
   - `subtitle`: "Com foco no atendimento: quanto o chat demora, se resolve e como trata saques e verificação. Publicamos tudo, menos spam e ofensas."
   - `lead_topic`: "support"
4. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `badges`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
5. **Review list** — block `sx/review-list`, variant `compact`, role `content`
   Purpose: Published reviews, newest first. Optional topic and rating filters (pure CSS, no JavaScript needed) and a CTA after every few reviews.
   - `mode`: "latest"
   - `limit`: "6"
   - `filters`: false
   - `cta_every`: "0"
6. **Topic scores** — block `sx/topic-scores`, variant `grid`, role `content`
   Purpose: Average score and review count per topic (payouts, verification, support...), each linking to those reviews.
7. **Editor box** — block `sx/editor-box`, variant `card`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Who looks after this page: editor card with role, bio, last update and the moderation policy, plus share links.
   - `share`: true
8. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Essas opiniões são reais?","a":"Sim. Cada opinião foi enviada por um jogador e lida por um moderador antes de ir ao ar. Publicamos também as negativas; só removemos spam, ofensas e dados pessoais."},{"q":"Vocês apagam opiniões negativas?","a":"Não. Removemos apenas spam, ofensas, dados pessoais e propaganda. Opiniões negativas continuam no site."},{"q":"Como falar com o suporte do Marlowe Club?","a":"Pelo chat no site e no app, 24 horas, ou por e-mail. Segundo as opiniões, o chat responde bem mais rápido que o e-mail."},{"q":"Vocês têm ligação com o Marlowe Club?","a":"Recebemos comissão por cadastros feitos pelos nossos links. Isso não muda quais opiniões publicamos."}]`
9. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `split`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Quer conhecer o Marlowe Club?"
   - `text`: "O cadastro leva poucos minutos. Proibido para menores de 18 anos. Jogue com responsabilidade."
   - `show_code`: false
10. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `columns`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
11. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `modal`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
12. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `bar`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

## Page `write-a-review.html`

- Title tag: Escrever uma opinião sobre o Marlowe Club
- Meta description: Conte sua experiência com o Marlowe Club. Publicamos opiniões positivas e negativas depois da moderação.
- The only H1: Escreva sua opinião sobre o Marlowe Club
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, BreadcrumbList
- Links to: `how-we-moderate.html`, `reviews.html`, `support-reviews.html`, `write-a-review.html`, `index.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `line`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `centered`, role `header`

## Page `how-we-moderate.html`

- Title tag: Como moderamos as opiniões sobre o Marlowe Club
- Meta description: Quais opiniões removemos, quais nunca removemos, de onde vêm as respostas do Marlowe Club e como ganhamos dinheiro.
- The only H1: Como moderamos as opiniões
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, BreadcrumbList
- Links to: `how-we-moderate.html`, `reviews.html`, `support-reviews.html`, `write-a-review.html`, `index.html`

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order above, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in "Rules you must not break" holds on every page.

_Long text and lists are shortened here (…, "[n items]"). For the full text run `php build/ai-brief.php sites/demos/<config>.json`._
